name: Site Guardian Dashboard
description: provides the core Site Guardian admin dashboard.
project_description:
This module provides a dashboard that can be used to display the information retrieved from multiple sites using the Site Guardian Dashboard API module.

 It is designed to be installed on an administrative site rather than on end user/public facing sites although there is no particular reason why it cannot be if so desired.

 See the Site Guardian PDF Report module for a module that integrates with this one and provides a PDF report on the status of a site being monitored by the Site Guardian API module.

 Very brief instructions (we will improve as soon as we can)...

 
 Add the module as normal using composer. 
 Enable the module. 
 You can now add a 'client' node and then a 'website' node. 
 Configure the website node with the details of the site you wish to monitor (you'll need the SG API key from the monitored site). 
 Visit the Site Guardian Dashboard (linked on the admin menu). 
 Refresh the website and you should see the sites info.
